# README Stats Playground

> A visual playground for github-readme-stats cards: choose a card, adjust its parameters in a form, preview it live, and copy the URL / Markdown / HTML for a GitHub profile README. Static site; nothing is uploaded and settings stay in the browser.

Supports all five github-readme-stats cards with every parameter as a form field: Stats (`/api`), Top Languages (`/api/top-langs`), Pin (`/api/pin`), WakaTime (`/api/wakatime`) and Gist (`/api/gist`). Common style (theme, colors, border, radius, cache, locale) is shared across cards. Rendering requires a github-readme-stats-compatible instance. github-readme-stats is no longer maintained; its API-compatible successor GitHub Stats Extended (https://github.com/stats-organization/github-stats-extended) runs a public instance at https://github-stats-extended.vercel.app, offered with one click. Self-hosted instances of either project also work, and a link can carry one via `instance=`.

## Open a pre-filled configuration

The page URL mirrors the card, using github-readme-stats' own parameter names and values:

    /?card=<stats|top-langs|pin|wakatime|gist>&<param>=<value>&…

Examples:

- `/?card=stats&username=octocat&theme=dark&show_icons=true&hide=issues,contribs`
- `/?card=top-langs&username=octocat&layout=compact&langs_count=8`
- `/?card=pin&username=anuraghazra&repo=github-readme-stats`

Add `instance=https://your-instance.example` so the link opens against that github-readme-stats deployment; without it the visitor is asked for one. Colors are hex without `#` (`title_color=2f80ed`); lists are comma-separated.
